verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's own marketing documents automatic tracking and alerts for changing federal, state, and local employment laws, plus AI compliance support that monitors regulatory changes. That covers the law-change trigger. Nothing shows alerts triggered by a new hire or a new work location; multi-state tax handling is automated filing, not a proactive alert. missing for 10: alerts triggered by new hires, alerts triggered by new locations or states, details on alert delivery and content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation

citations.quote: Stay ahead of changing federal, state, and local employment laws, with automatic tracking and alerts.
Get AI-powered compliance support to answer your questions, generate HR documents, monitor regulatory changes
